entry.title: New: Resolution 43 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES A GRANT OF EASEMENT FOR UTILITY PURPOSES TO HAWAIʻI ELECTRIC LIGHT COMPANY, INC., OVER TAX MAP KEY: 6-8-041:023 (POR.)

Allows for a grant of easement from the County of Hawaiʻi to provide electrical service to the new Keolalani at Waikoloa subdivision in South Kohala and allow for the installation of vacuum switch equipment, with an independent appraisal valued at $590.
